title: click: Bug report (issue #2790) from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is click (an open-source Python library). Bug report (issue #2790) from a user of this library:

> Our group uses `context_settings={"help_option_names": ["-h", "--help"]}`, and a subcommand has its own `--host/-h` option. When you make a usage mistake in that subcommand, the error ends with `Try 'cli foo -h' for help.`, but `-h` there means `--host`, so the hint is wrong. The hint should only suggest help option names the command actually still accepts (preferring the longest, like `--help`), and show no hint if none are left.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
